name: MNT-0003 Formal Closure

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/mnt-0003-close-20260907
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/mnt-0003-close.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  close:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout approved closure baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: 209ad92b2fce9032949ad4053ca07fd7911a6817

      - name: Configure Git identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "Monad EOS Automation"
          git config user.email "eos-automation@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Confirm closure authority and verification state
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos state status
          grep '^status: "VERIFYING"' engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md
          grep '^\*\*State:\*\* VERIFYING' engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md
          grep '^status: "Accepted"' engineering/reviews/MNT-0003-REVIEW.md
          grep '^\*\*Decision:\*\* ACCEPTED' engineering/reviews/MNT-0003-REVIEW.md
          grep '^\*\*Disposition:\*\* \*\*APPROVED\*\*' engineering/reviews/DECISION-0010-2026-09-07-mnt-0003-closure-approval.md
          grep '> I approve MNT-0003 closure\.' engineering/reviews/DECISION-0010-2026-09-07-mnt-0003-closure-approval.md
          grep '^\*\*Disposition:\*\* PASS — RECOMMEND MNT-0003 CLOSURE' engineering/reviews/MNT-0003-EVENT-LEDGER-MERGE-SAFETY-VERIFICATION.md

      - name: Finalize maintenance closure evidence
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path('engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md')
          text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          old = '## Closure Evidence\n\nPending implementation and verification.'
          new = '''## Closure Evidence

Implementation and verification are complete.

Production integration checkpoints:

- `3fb8b8995e3d92ddab28115190fd6ad21ac4cd4c` — event-history integrity implementation;
- `0072d7f4bed954f2832db7403933b5fb9bf37e31` — removal of temporary integration machinery;
- `8a9deb9fbc5c49458605aa8e1a73e63947263ab8` — synchronized post-integration machine projection;
- `2d2247c673dd7f48c210a8063afe9135e4cd7ea8` — independently refreshed deterministic trace projection;
- `7dfe8323153f1d4bbbd93183f932b194e216775b` — formal MNT-0003 verification checkpoint.

Dedicated verification:

`engineering/reviews/MNT-0003-EVENT-LEDGER-MERGE-SAFETY-VERIFICATION.md`

Verification disposition:

**PASS — RECOMMEND MNT-0003 CLOSURE**

Engineering closure review:

`engineering/reviews/MNT-0003-REVIEW.md`

Review disposition:

**ACCEPTED**

Human closure authority:

`engineering/reviews/DECISION-0010-2026-09-07-mnt-0003-closure-approval.md`

Explicit Human Project Steward authority statement:

> I approve MNT-0003 closure.

Formal lifecycle closure proceeds through the ordinary `MNT_CLOSE` gate with no override.'''
          if old not in text:
              raise SystemExit('expected pending Closure Evidence marker not found')
          path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding='utf-8')
          PY
          git diff --check -- engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md

      - name: Converge generated trace before closure
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos verify >/tmp/mnt-0003-pre-close-eosv.txt
          grep 'EOSV RESULT: PASS' /tmp/mnt-0003-pre-close-eosv.txt
          before="$(sha256sum .eos/trace-edges.tsv | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          ./scripts/eos verify >/tmp/mnt-0003-pre-close-repeat.txt
          after="$(sha256sum .eos/trace-edges.tsv | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          test "$before" = "$after"
          grep 'EOSV RESULT: PASS' /tmp/mnt-0003-pre-close-repeat.txt

      - name: Execute ordinary MNT close gate
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos maintain close MNT-0003
          ./scripts/eos state status
          grep '^MNT-0003' .eos/maintenance.tsv | grep 'CLOSED'
          grep '^status: "CLOSED"' engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md
          grep '^\*\*State:\*\* CLOSED' engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md

      - name: Reverify closed state and trace determinism
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos verify >/tmp/mnt-0003-post-close-eosv.txt
          grep 'EOSV RESULT: PASS' /tmp/mnt-0003-post-close-eosv.txt
          before="$(sha256sum .eos/trace-edges.tsv | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          ./scripts/eos verify >/tmp/mnt-0003-post-close-repeat.txt
          after="$(sha256sum .eos/trace-edges.tsv | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          test "$before" = "$after"
          grep 'EOSV RESULT: PASS' /tmp/mnt-0003-post-close-repeat.txt
          ./scripts/eos state status

      - name: Enforce bounded closure diff
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import subprocess
          allowed = {
              '.eos/events.jsonl',
              '.eos/maintenance.tsv',
              '.eos/state/current.json',
              '.eos/state/projections.json',
              '.eos/trace-edges.tsv',
              'engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md',
          }
          changed = set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'], text=True).splitlines())
          untracked = set(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'], text=True).splitlines())
          observed = changed | untracked
          unexpected = sorted(observed - allowed)
          if unexpected:
              raise SystemExit('unexpected closure changes: ' + ', '.join(unexpected))
          required = {
              '.eos/events.jsonl',
              '.eos/maintenance.tsv',
              '.eos/state/current.json',
              '.eos/state/projections.json',
              'engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md',
          }
          missing = sorted(required - observed)
          if missing:
              raise SystemExit('missing expected closure changes: ' + ', '.join(missing))
          print('bounded closure diff: PASS')
          PY
          git diff --check -- . ':!.eos/*.tsv'

      - name: Commit formal closure
        run: |
          git add \
            .eos/events.jsonl \
            .eos/maintenance.tsv \
            .eos/state/current.json \
            .eos/state/projections.json \
            .eos/trace-edges.tsv \
            engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md
          git diff --cached --check -- . ':!.eos/*.tsv'
          git commit -m "chore(eos): close MNT-0003"

      - name: Publish immutable closure result
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/automation/mnt-0003-close-result-20260907
